description: Official MIT-licensed local Claude plugin and stdio MCP bridge for Cadre, an Apple Silicon macOS screen recorder and non-destructive video editor. With Cadre open, agents can record, inspect timelines, apply reversible cuts, zooms, captions and styling, save, preview, and export MP4. Recording, editing, and preview are free; Cadre Pro is required only for export.

notes: The stdio process needs no user-supplied credential. It reads Cadre's per-launch rotating bearer token from a private mode-0600 connection file and uses it only for authenticated 127.0.0.1 loopback requests.

license: MIT for the plugin; the required Cadre companion app is proprietary

notes: Issue #1966 was submitted by the Cadre project maintainer. The public plugin README, plugin manifest, evidence page, and current Agent API documentation support the transport, local bearer-token boundary, docs URL, license split, supported clients, and 57-tool count.
